Title: How to Organise Clothes in a Wardrobe: 7 Steps
Description: How to organise clothes in a wardrobe in 7 steps: empty and sort into four piles, plan zones, add a second rail, hang what creases and fold what stretches, switch to slim matching hangers, file-fold drawers and store off-season clothes clean.

Title: Wardrobe Organisation Tips: The Space Each Item Needs
